name: SF-36 (Short Form Health Survey)
description: A 36-item self-report health survey measuring eight health domains: physical functioning, role physical, bodily pain, general health, vitality, social functioning, role emotional, and mental health.
reputation: Most widely used generic health outcome measure; population norms for 40+ countries; used in clinical trials.
notes: Licensing required for commercial use; free RAND version available; ceiling effects in healthy populations.
